name: io.github.adam121393/package-intel
description: Health scores, dependency graphs, and vulnerability data for npm and PyPI packages. Lets a coding agent check whether a dependency is safe, maintained, and current before adding it. Pay-per-call in USDC over x402.

environmentVariables.name: API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the paid API.

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id for payments. eip155:8453 is Base mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet funded with USDC on NETWORK, used to pay per call. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet: this is a hot key that spends automatically.
